quotes.text: For a for-of loop over Map.values(), use the iterable directly. D203232 removed an unnecessary spread and the author confirmed values() is iterable. Materialize an array when the operation needs map/some/index access or a stable snapshot during mutations. The same review declined a blanket removal where an array method improved clarity.
